examples.title: Pickup probe

SignalSource.description: Magnetic field measurement from probe TC-5 used for real-time plasma control. Measures the local poloidal magnetic field to provide feedback for plasma position and shape control.

examples.note: Source, binding and DD target found in the live graph.

queries.name: index_inventory
queries.query: SHOW INDEXES YIELD labelsOrTypes, properties, state, type WHERE any(label IN labelsOrTypes WHERE label IN $labels) AND type IN ['RANGE', 'TEXT'] RETURN labelsOrTypes, properties, state, type LIMIT 100

queries.name: facility_control
queries.query: MATCH (f:Facility {id: $facility}) USING INDEX f:Facility(id) RETURN f.id AS id LIMIT 1

queries.name: FacilityPath
queries.query: MATCH (n:FacilityPath {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:FacilityPath(facility_id) RETURN count(n) AS total, count(n.facility_id) AS with_facility_id, count(n.status) AS with_status

queries.name: CodeFile
queries.query: MATCH (n:CodeFile {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:CodeFile(facility_id) RETURN count(n) AS total, count(n.facility_id) AS with_facility_id, count(n.status) AS with_status

queries.name: Document
queries.query: MATCH (n:Document {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:Document(facility_id) RETURN count(n) AS total, count(n.facility_id) AS with_facility_id, count(n.status) AS with_status

queries.name: WikiPage
queries.query: MATCH (n:WikiPage {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:WikiPage(facility_id) RETURN count(n) AS total, count(n.facility_id) AS with_facility_id, count(n.status) AS with_status

queries.name: FacilitySignal
queries.query: MATCH (n:FacilitySignal {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:FacilitySignal(facility_id) RETURN count(n) AS total, count(n.facility_id) AS with_facility_id, count(n.status) AS with_status

queries.name: SignalSource
queries.query: MATCH (n:SignalSource {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:SignalSource(facility_id) RETURN count(n) AS total, count(n.facility_id) AS with_facility_id, count(n.status) AS with_status

queries.name: IMASMapping
queries.query: MATCH (n:IMASMapping {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:IMASMapping(facility_id) RETURN count(n) AS total, count(n.facility_id) AS with_facility_id, count(n.status) AS with_status

queries.name: signal_statuses
queries.query: MATCH (n:FacilitySignal {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:FacilitySignal(facility_id) RETURN n.status AS status, count(n) AS count ORDER BY status LIMIT 30

queries.name: candidate_routes
queries.query: MATCH (n:SignalSource {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:SignalSource(facility_id) RETURN n.candidate_route AS route, count(n) AS count ORDER BY route LIMIT 20

queries.name: bindings
queries.query: MATCH (s:SignalSource {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX s:SignalSource(facility_id) MATCH (s)-[r:MAPS_TO_IMAS]->(n:IMASNode) RETURN count(r) AS count

queries.name: mapping_statuses
queries.query: MATCH (n:IMASMapping {facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX n:IMASMapping(facility_id) RETURN n.ids_name AS ids, n.status AS status, count(n) AS count ORDER BY ids, status LIMIT 30

queries.name: pickup-probe_source
queries.query: MATCH (s:SignalSource {id: $source, facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX s:SignalSource(id) RETURN s {.id, .group_key, .status, .description} AS record LIMIT 1

record.description: Magnetic field measurement from probe TC-5 used for real-time plasma control. Measures the local poloidal magnetic field to provide feedback for plasma position and shape control.

queries.name: pickup-probe_edge
queries.query: MATCH (s:SignalSource {id: $source, facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX s:SignalSource(id) MATCH (s)-[r:MAPS_TO_IMAS]->(n:IMASNode {id: $target}) RETURN r {.source_property, .transform_expression, .source_units, .target_units, .cocos_label, .confidence, .evidence, .mapping_type, .error_type, .derived_from} AS record LIMIT 2

queries.name: pickup-probe_target
queries.query: MATCH (n:IMASNode {id: $target}) USING INDEX n:IMASNode(id) RETURN n {.id, .data_type, .unit, .cocos_transformation_type} AS record LIMIT 1

queries.name: pf-coil-current_source
queries.query: MATCH (s:SignalSource {id: $source, facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX s:SignalSource(id) RETURN s {.id, .group_key, .status, .description} AS record LIMIT 1

queries.name: pf-coil-current_edge
queries.query: MATCH (s:SignalSource {id: $source, facility_id: $facility}) USING INDEX s:SignalSource(id) MATCH (s)-[r:MAPS_TO_IMAS]->(n:IMASNode {id: $target}) RETURN r {.source_property, .transform_expression, .source_units, .target_units, .cocos_label, .confidence, .evidence, .mapping_type, .error_type, .derived_from} AS record LIMIT 2

queries.name: pf-coil-current_target
queries.query: MATCH (n:IMASNode {id: $target}) USING INDEX n:IMASNode(id) RETURN n {.id, .data_type, .unit, .cocos_transformation_type} AS record LIMIT 1
